option_relations.rationale: Ectopic Atrial Tachycardia is a type of supraventricular tachycardia with automatic mechanism, matching the description of option A.
Intra-atrial reentrant tachycardia (IART) is a type of supraventricular tachycardia with re-entrant mechanism, matching the description of option B.
Atrial Tachycardia with variable block is a type of supraventricular tachycardia with automatic mechanism, matching the description of option C.
Atrial Flutter with variable conduction does not match any of the provided leaf labels.
